story.so_that: I can durably automate complete multi-step workflows of agentic action
story.as_a: Software Engineer, and AI Process Designer
story.i_want: a working example of the Story Analysis Workflow of the SDLC process using a publicly available workflow engine

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A working example of the Story Analysis Workflow of the SDLC process using Cadence
The implemented workflow is documented and can be used by others
The implemented workflow demonstrates flow of agentic actions, including tool calls and state management, retry-loops, and punching out to the human in cases of ambiguity or uncertainty
Workflow actions are auditable and traceable after workflow completion
Agentic Workflow actions affect the repository state (e.g., create files, update documentation)
Workflow is repeatable, producing similar results when given the same inputs
Happy path: all SDLC skill Activities succeed on first attempt with no human escalation needed
Error handling: an Activity fails repeatedly and exhausts its RetryPolicy
Human escalation timeout: no human responds to an escalation Signal within a bounded wait
Domain/task-list scoping: only Workers and clients configured for the workflow's Cadence domain and task list can start, signal, or execute it
An analysis that fails grade-story-analysis's pass threshold is repaired via repair-story-analysis and re-graded
The grade-repair cycle is bounded to a maximum of 3 attempts

edge_cases.criterion: Empty or null story document input
Very large story document exceeds Cadence input/Activity payload size limits
Special characters/unicode in the story text
First-time use: no Cadence domain registered yet
Concurrent workflow executions for the same story
Worker crash mid-Activity and workflow resumption via replay
Duplicate/idempotent Activity execution due to retries

ui: Cadence Web UI (optional, local dev) for observing WorkflowExecution history and status
api: Cadence frontend gRPC API: StartWorkflowExecution, SignalWorkflowExecution, QueryWorkflowExecution, DescribeWorkflowExecution
cadence CLI for starting, signaling, and inspecting workflow runs
database: Cadence service persistence store (embedded SQLite for local dev; Cassandra/MySQL/PostgreSQL for production)
external_services: Cadence Worker process(es) polling the Story Analysis Workflow task list

steps.description: Implement the repair-story-analysis skill (SKILL.md, schema, verify.sh) to close the grade/repair feedback loop
Author the 4-step Cadence Workflow in Python: extract-story-intent -> analyze-story -> grade-story-analysis -> bounded repair/grade loop (max 3 attempts)
Implement deterministic, replay-safe Activity wrappers for the four SDLC skills with repository file I/O and output validation
Register the Worker, domain, and task list; start the Worker polling process
Implement the human_response Signal and get_status Query with a timer-guarded Selector for human-in-the-loop escalation
Create the workflow starter/client script and cadence CLI helper to register the domain and trigger a run from a story document
Provision and document the local embedded-SQLite Cadence server and persistence store for development
Write the README/runbook so another engineer can install, configure, and run the example independently

unit_tests.description: repair-story-analysis consumes the full analysis-grade JSON and produces a repaired analysis
Workflow attempt counter stops at 3 and escalates to a human Signal
Signal/Query payload parsing and timer guard raise the expected events

integration_tests.description: Full Story Analysis Workflow run against the local Cadence server creates repository files and completes
Grade-repair loop is exercised by a failing grade; repair runs and re-grades within 3 attempts
Activity retry exhausts and the Workflow surfaces a human escalation

e2e_tests.description: Trigger a run from a story document via the CLI starter, then inspect cadence workflow describe and the Cadence Web UI for the complete Event History

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Cadence Python SDK has feature gaps compared to the Go/Java clients (e.g., certain query/signal patterns)
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Check cadence-workflow-orchestration/03-python-client/feature-gaps.md before relying on advanced features; prefer supported patterns and add integration tests for each SDK feature used

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Workflow code contains non-deterministic or side-effecting logic that breaks Cadence replay
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Keep Workflow code pure; move all file I/O, LLM calls, and time/UUID generation to Activities; enforce deterministic Workflow with unit tests and a replay test

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Grade/repair loop could run unbounded or repeatedly invoke costly Activities
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Track attempt count in Workflow state and hard-cap at 3 before escalating to a human Signal; no activity-level re-invocation without an attempt increment

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Human escalation Signal is never answered, leaving the Workflow running indefinitely
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Wrap the Signal await in a Cadence Selector with a bounded timer; after timeout, record the timeout in Event History and fail/complete gracefully

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Repeated Activity retries produce duplicate or corrupted repository files
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Make each skill file write idempotent (overwrite-safe with stable names); validate final files with per-skill verify.sh after forced retries

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Worker crash or Cadence service outage loses in-flight work
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Rely on Cadence durable Event History for replay; keep Activities deterministic and idempotent; test Worker restart by killing and restarting the process mid-run
